name: Tobin Marsh
epithet: Youngest knight of the Ninth Lance
appearance: Nineteen years old, the youngest of the sixty knights of the Ninth Lance. The chronicle gives him no face and no colors: only his age, his place at Darrow's left in the crossing, and his singing, which was bad and did not stop. He rode his own horse into the Wend at Harrow Ford.
last_seen_doing: Going under his own horse in the current of the Wend, on the second heartbeat, as the Grace went out of the Ninth midstream.
now: He went under the Wend at Harrow Ford and did not come back. Nineteen of the Ninth did. Darrow knows the names of the other forty-one and has not said them.
story_so_far: He rode with the Ninth Lance at Harrow Ford, at Darrow's left, when the Sixth and the Ninth were sent to clear the ford. Halfway across, the Grace went out of the Ninth: horses stumbled, lances dipped, and Tobin went under his own horse in the current. Darrow came off his mare and turned toward him, and on that turn the knee went. Nineteen of the Ninth came back from Harrow Ford.

known_facts.fact: He was nineteen, the youngest knight of the Ninth Lance.
He rode at Darrow's left in the crossing and went under his own horse in the current when the Grace left the Ninth midstream.
When Darrow came off his mare, his first instinct was to get to Tobin and cover the left; the knee went on that turn.

relationships.label: his captain
relationships.note: In the river Darrow's first instinct was to turn toward him; the knee went on the turn, and Darrow has not said his name since.
